text:
The frequency of a sound wave increases from 31000Hz to 32000Hz.
What is the nature of the wave and how does it sound to a human with normal hearing?
A
It is a longitudinal wave with a decreasing pitch.
B
It is a transverse wave with an increasing pitch.
C
It is a longitudinal wave that cannot be heard by a human with normal hearing.
D
It is a transverse wave that cannot be heard by a human with normal hearing.

options.label: A
options.text: It is a longitudinal wave with a decreasing pitch.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a transverse wave with an increasing pitch.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a longitudinal wave that cannot be heard by a human with normal hearing.
